subject: S-02
question: who sets "location"
reach: cross-cutting: markets and the seller's country
reading: A reading: the location the point asks about is the store's own country and address, set by the seller in the store's general settings (CM-ACC-006: WooCommerce's business address, BigCommerce's Store Profile and Default Country under Manage Settings), at sign-up (CM-ONB-001: Shopify's I'm located in:, Salla's حدد من أي دولة تسجل متجرك, Zid's حدد موقعك) and, on Shopify, on the business entity behind the staff and organization permissions (CM-ACC-004). The seller, a staff role or the platform's default setting it is each platform's core; the thing set is the seller's country, which S-02's E2 has every area read, so cross-cutting.

subject: S-02

Each is a check a capability runs, not a value every area holds.
